paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
heading: Bawngpi San Vute
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai TOUPA thupiak dan ahi. Israel suante bawngla san, dembei, gensiatbei, hakkol bulhsak ngei het louh na kiang a hon kai ding in hilh un.
english: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

paite: Siampu Eleazar na pe ding a, ama'n giahphual pua ah apikhe dia, ama ah mi khat in agou ding hi.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

paite: Siampu Eleazar in akhut in asisan ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah asisan sagihvei atheh ding.
english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

paite: Mi khat in huai bawngla amitmuh in ahal dia; avun, asa, asisan leh a-ek ahalmang ding hi.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

paite: Siampu in sidar sing, hissop leh khau san ala dia, abawngla hal uah apailut ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

paite: Siampu in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, huai khit in giahphual ah ahoh dia, nitaklam tan in siampu siang lou ahi ding.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Ahal mi in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Mi asiang khat in bawngla vu alakhawm dia, giahphual pua a mun siang a ngaih ah akoih dia, Israel suan mipi omkhawmte kisiansakna tui dia zat ding ahi. Hiai khelh siansakna ahi.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

paite: Bawngla vu lakhawm mi in apuansilhte asawp dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Hiai Israel suante leh namdang akiang ua omte a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

paite: "Kuapeuh siluang khoih peuhmah ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
heading: Misi Luang Toh Kisukkhak
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

paite: Amah ani thum ni in akisiangsak dia, ani sagih ni in asiang ding. Himahleh, ani thum ni a akisiansak keileh ani sagih ni in leng asiang kei ding hi.
english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

paite: Kuapeuh siluang khoihmi, akisiansak keileh TOUPA biakbuk ahihnin ahi. Huai mi Israel mite a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui atung a atheh louh ziak in asiang kei dia, atung ah asianlouhna a-om lai hi.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

paite: "Puanin a mi asihleh hiai adan ding ahi. Puanin a lut peuhmah leh puanin sung a om peuhmahte ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

paite: Tui-um belsuan kihong, sit louh peuhmah siang lou ahi uh.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

paite: Gamlak a namsau a thah hiam, misi luang hiam, mihing guh hiam, han hiam mi'n akhoihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

paite: "Asiangloute a tuam ding in khelh thoihna vu ala ding ua, bel ah tuikhuk tui toh asung ding uhi.
english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

paite: Misiang in, hissop ala dia, tui ah adiah dia, puanin tung, tui-um belsuan tengteng, huai a om mi tengteng, guh hiam, thah siluang hiam, misi luang hiam, han hiam khoih mite tung ah atheh ding.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

paite: Misiang in ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in misiang lou atheh dia, ani sagih ni in ahihsiang dia; apuansilhte asawp dia, akisil dia, nitaklam in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

paite: "Misiang lou kisiangsak lou in TOUPA mun siangthou ahihnit ziak in huai mi omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh louh ahi a, siang lou ahi.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

paite: Hiai amau a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh peuhmah in apuansilhte asawp dia; akisiansakna tui khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

paite: Misiang lou in akhoih peuhmah siang lou ahi zel dia; huai khoihmi kuapeuh nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding," achi hi.
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
